after.en: No data table, number, method, control, rubric, actual-action requirement or personal-preparation boundary of a chosen case is changed. Only the global fixed-case combination is corrected; ASA-specific assays remain in that case, not as a universal method for the general goal.

e7MaterialDiffs.before: Actual personal isolation/work-up and specific own-sample analysis are mandatory. Reaction preparation is a separate labelled context/carrier, not a universal ASA reaction criterion. Complete BCP self-prepared-source duty remains open without actual personal preparation provenance. Both practical cases remain required.
e7MaterialDiffs.after: Actual personal isolation/work-up and all specific assay requirements remain mandatory within this chosen ASA case. Preparation stays a separate labelled context. The complete BCP self-prepared-source duty remains open without actual own preparation provenance. No fixed combination of both example cases is required for the general goal.

e7MaterialDiffs.before: Both cases required. Salt06-a retains actual isolation/recovery. Work-up06-b requires actual personal isolation, purification, specific assays, original records and practical transfer. External preparation data do not demonstrate own synthesis or complete the BCP self-prepared-source duty. No practice value substitutes for personal performance.
e7MaterialDiffs.after: Alternative example cases, not a mandatory two-case quota. All seven general P expectations, minimum two independent demonstrations, fresh variation and independent transfer remain required. A suitably complete integrated practical performance can suffice; the ASA case includes such work-up, assays and fresh practical transfer. The salt case alone supplies no actual purity assay and therefore does not by itself close all expectations. If ASA is chosen, keep every whole case requirement and its complete stock/blank protocol. BCP12/13.4.3 remains open without actual personal preparation plus own subsequent work-up/testing; external stock or practice data are never personal execution.
